recipes.name: Elvis Burger
instructions: To prepare the bananas for cooking, begin by peeling them. Cut each banana in half crosswise, and then slice each half lengthwise so that you have 4 pieces in total.
Coat a large nonstick pan with cooking spray and place the banana pieces in the pan. Sprinkle the brown sugar on top of the bananas.

Cook the bananas over medium heat for 5 minutes without flipping them. Once the 5 minutes are up, remove the pan from the heat and cover the top with a lid. Let the bananas sit while you cook the burgers.
Preheat your cast iron grill over medium-high heat.
Weigh your portion of ground beef and shape into a patty. Season both sides of the patty with salt and pepper.
Place the patty on the grill or skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
During the last minute of cooking, add a slice of cheese to the patty and let it melt.
Place the bun heel on plate.
Spread peanut butter over top bun.
Finish with the top half of the bun.
